# Setup

If you are not working in Posit Cloud, or you do not have the `data/` and `code/` directories showing up in Posit Cloud, you can download them by running:

```r
# Download workshop materials (code + data)
download.file(
  url = "https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/archive/refs/heads/main.zip",
  destfile = "workshop-materials.zip"
)

# Unzip and move contents to root
unzip("workshop-materials.zip")
file.copy(
  list.files("ellmer-latinr-main", full.names = TRUE),
  ".", recursive = TRUE)
unlink("ellmer-latinr-main", recursive = TRUE)
```

# Code

There is one R script per section of the workshop in the `code/` directory. Each script ends with the "Your turn" exercises for that section. Section 2 is optional and may be skipped depending on time.

| Section | Script |
|---|---|
| 1 - Getting Started with LLMs in R | [`code/01-getting-started.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/01-getting-started.R) |
| 2 - Prompt Engineering (optional) | [`code/02-prompt-engineering.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/02-prompt-engineering.R) |
| 3 - Extracting Structured Data | [`code/03-structured-data.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/03-structured-data.R) |
| 4 - Tool Calling | [`code/04-tool-calling.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/04-tool-calling.R) |

## 1 - Getting Started with LLMs in R

Script: [`code/01-getting-started.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/01-getting-started.R)

### Your turn

1.  Set up your API key using `usethis::edit_r_environ()` + restart R
2.  Start a conversation: `chat_openrouter(model = "openai/gpt-6.1-terra")`
3.  Ask what the most popular dog breed was in 1995 and then in 2026

## 2 - Prompt Engineering (optional)

Script: [`code/02-prompt-engineering.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/02-prompt-engineering.R)

### Your turn

1. Pick a different dog from the dataset and run the prompt on it
2. Add one more field to the output format that **you** would want to know before adopting a dog

## 3 - Extracting Structured Data

Script: [`code/03-structured-data.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/03-structured-data.R)

### Your turn

1. Pick a different dog from the dataset
2. Extract the name and age group using `chat_structured()`
3. Process all dogs using `parallel_chat_structured()`
4. **Bonus:** Add a new field for the dog's energy level using `type_enum()` with choices like "Low", "Medium", "High"

## 4 - Tool Calling

Script: [`code/04-tool-calling.R`](https://github.com/thisisnic/ellmer-latinr/blob/main/code/04-tool-calling.R)

### Your turn

1. Ask the assistant to save a different shortlist, and approve it this time
2. Change the rule in `on_tool_request()` so saving is only ever allowed to files ending in `.txt`, without asking
3. **Bonus:** log every tool call (name and arguments) to a data frame using `on_tool_request()`, so you can see what the model did during a chat
